main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Quatuor coronatorum martyrum ossibus alta re datum 108

Rauennae archiepiscopus à pont. Rom. occupatus 217

page.notes: The page is cut off at the foot: the last entry, "regis Rom. electiones pe / ues", continues beyond the scan and is not complete. "Rauennam translata pō tificis" has the abbreviation pō before a line-end break; the word after "pō" is partly hidden. "ossibus" is read from a long-s form (ofibus on the scan), so the double s is inferred. "fi[?]tus" is uncertain; likely "fictus". The first entry of the left column has no page number visible beyond 108. No page number, running head or catchword is printed on this page.
